summary: The TechnicalRoundup episode analyzes a market where major cryptocurrencies are stuck in consolidation between key levels. BTC is trading in the middle of its monthly range (35-37 support, 43-47 resistance) with monthly timeframe being the guide. ETH has failed its bullish retest scenario after closing below 3,000, while LUNA shows weak patterns after failing its weekly breakout above 100. SOL and AVAX are also in no-trade zones. The overall theme is patience - wait for monthly levels to be reached rather than trading in the middle of ranges.
